correctness.rationale: The rational boundary rows were reconstructed from clamped cubic B-spline evaluation; strict diagonal dominance and B-spline total nonnegativity imply a positive simple spectrum. The exact parity equations reduce the subband count to two scalar root problems. The sign of the p/q derivative, a positive octic certificate for the logarithmic elasticity derivative, and the repeated-root condition at lambda=1/3 establish every n>=4. Simple-root perturbation proves the exponential splitting. The packaged checker passed exact symbolic tests and finite eigenvalue comparisons; it is corroboration rather than an infinite proof.
